2607.26634.title: Guarding Organizations Against Malware Risk: A Novel Graph-Based Malware Detection Method
2607.26634.paper_summary: Organizational digitalization expands cybersecurity risks, making cybersecurity an increasingly important research area in Information Systems (IS). Among these risks, malware has become a pervasive and destructive threat. Byte-based machine learning (ML) methods are widely used for malware detection but remain vulnerable to evasive behaviors that manipulate raw bytes to evade detection. Graph-based methods are less affected by such manipulations because they represent software as program graphs that capture execution behavior. However, they do not explicitly identify cohesive groups of basic blocks that jointly realize meaningful program behaviors, nor do they learn sufficiently expressive program graph representations for accurate detection. To this end, we propose MalGuard, a graph-based malware detection method for organizational malware risk management. MalGuard introduces two methodological innovations: an operational role identification approach and a program graph representation learning method. The former identifies these cohesive groups of basic blocks as operational roles, enabling the detector to capture program behaviors that may not be visible from isolated basic blocks. The latter learns expressive program graph representations by modeling interactions among operational roles, preserving sparse malicious signals, and capturing hierarchical graph structure. Extensive experiments show that MalGuard improves detection performance and reduces the expected cost of undetected malware.
2607.26634.paper_summary_zh: 組織數位化擴大了網路安全風險，使得網路安全成為資訊系統（IS）中越來越重要的研究領域。<lb/>在這些風險中，惡意軟體已成為一種普遍且具破壞性的威脅。<lb/>基於位元組的機器學習（ML）方法廣泛用於惡意軟體檢測，但仍然容易受到操控原始位元組以逃避檢測的規避行為的影響。<lb/>基於圖的方法則不太受這種操控的影響，因為它們將軟體表示為捕捉執行行為的程式圖。<lb/>然而，它們並未明確識別共同實現有意義程式行為的基本區塊的凝聚群體，也未學習足夠表達的程式圖表示以進行準確檢測。<lb/>為此，我們提出了MalGuard，一種用於組織惡意軟體風險管理的基於圖的惡意軟體檢測方法。<lb/>MalGuard引入了兩項方法論創新：一種操作角色識別方法和一種程式圖表示學習方法。<lb/>前者將這些凝聚的基本區塊識別為操作角色，使檢測器能夠捕捉可能無法從孤立基本區塊中看出的程式行為。<lb/>後者通過建模操作角色之間的互動來學習表達性的程式圖表示，保留稀疏的惡意信號，並捕捉層次圖結構。<lb/>大量實驗顯示，MalGuard提高了檢測性能並降低了未檢測惡意軟體的預期成本。
